26D readiness checklist (PDF)

A printable checklist for the 26D update: the baseline regression checks, the opt-ins Oracle lists as ending with 26D, the HCM pages that switch to Redwood by default in 26D (with the profile option names Oracle gives), and links to Oracle's 26D What's New documents.

Oracle's 26D What's New documents are still being revised, so treat this checklist as preliminary and confirm details on the linked Oracle pages.

Download the 26D checklist (PDF) Or read the 26D page on the site →

Fusion quarterly update calendar (.ics)

Calendar entries for the 26D and 27A test and production update windows for cohorts A, B and C. Import it into Outlook, Google Calendar or Apple Calendar and delete the cohorts you're not in.

Oracle publishes the rule rather than a public list of dates: test environments update on the first Friday of the update month and production on the third Friday (in Middle East regions, on the Thursday before). The dates in this file follow that rule and are labelled as typical. Your own dates are in the Oracle Cloud Console. Source: Oracle Fusion Insider, "Quarterly updates made easy".
